system.effect: When you successfully Shove a creature, that creature takes an amount of bludgeoning damage equal to your Might modifier (or double that amount on a Critical Success). This damage increases by 2 when you become an expert in Armored Fighting, 6 when you become a master, and 12 when you become legendary.
system.description: When you push a foe away, you put the entire force of your Full Plate harness into it.
